name: 施設情報の修正と追加の案内
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse component LH01-0033 施設情報の修正と追加の案内. Input1 ORIGINAL Google Maps screenshot is authoritative for icon geometry, optical weight, row anatomy, proportions and low-emphasis final-row state; source region x47 y1715 width1080 height520. Input2 rough native mock SECONDARY Japanese content/layout. Mock document/naked-check/contact-card icons are WRONG and its mint discs are not the official direction. Input3 approved bus STYLE ONLY.
One compact white rounded list card on purewhite#FFFFFF, subtle neutral border, restrained shadow, exactly three horizontal action rows separated by thin neutral dividers. Bare utility icons aligned left, Japanese text aligned in one column; compact generous-enough hit-area appearance. No circular icon backgrounds.
Row1 original diagonal PENCIL glyph, rectangular outline shaft with inset white slot, small graphite point bottomleft, roundedcap upperright, matching original proportions/optical weight; slate#526173. Exact text "情報の修正を提案" in ink#1D1D1D.
Row2 original FILLED SHIELD with white CHECK cutout, pointedbottom and angledtop, matching source shape; slate#526173. Exact text "この施設の管理者ですか" in ink. This is a claim-management action, NOT a verified-success status and not a naked checkmark.
Row3 original TELEPHONE HANDSET glyph, curved receiver with two thick terminals, angled upperleft-to-lowerright, as source; muted neutralgray. Exact text "電話番号を追加" in matching mutedgray#808789. Preserve the original lower-emphasis missing-phone suggestion state, without inventing a phone number or declaring it disabled.
Accent decision: original blue first two utility icons adapt to coherent slate. All rows unselected, no primary CTA, so no forced green or random colors. Final-row mutedgray retained as real visible emphasis difference. No mint circles, badges, chevrons, added headings, extra text or buttons. Locked Meiryo Regular40014/24 text,tracking0; match native regular strokeweight rather than bold labels. Original anatomy priority over mock substitutes. Frontal high-resolution horizontal compact card about2:1 with modest white margins, readable Japanese, consistent baselines and spacing, no clipping. Exclude rest of screen/device/logos.
reviewNotes: Original/native/output visibly compared. Original diagonal pencil, filled shield with white check and curved phonehandset restored instead of rough document/check/contactcard;mint discs removed. Exact three Japanese labels;firsttwo slate icons/ink labels, third phone and label mutedgray matching original loweremphasis. No disabled-interaction or verified-success assertion. Regular text, row alignment/dividers and clipping checked;purewhite rounded panel, neutral edge/shadow. Agent-reviewed raster candidate only, not owner approval/native editability/runtime.
